observations: body L1-L4: «Muḥyī ad–dīn al–Maghrabī», «Abrāhām bar Ḥiyyā’» and «Leonem de Balneolis» are letter-spaced; «ad–dīn» and «al–Maghrabī» have long dashes (5.5 pt each), and the dash before «Eadem» measures 9.7 pt.

body L5-L8: «Ibn al–A‘lam», «Naṣīr ad–dīn aṭ–Ṭūsī», «Quṭb ad–dīn Maḥmūd ash–Shīrāzī», «Oloug Beg», «Albatenio», divided between L7 and L8, and «Yōsēph ben Elī‘ezer» are letter-spaced, their long dashes 5.4 to 5.5 pt; the dash before «False» measures 10.3 pt. 3600″ : 70 = 51″ 3/7 = 51″ 25‴ 42ⁱᵛ 51ᵛ 3/7, as printed.
body L9-L10: «Ibn Yūnus», «Caussin» and «Delambre» are letter-spaced. 3600″ : 70 1/4 = 51″ 14‴ 43ⁱᵛ 59ᵛ 8ᵛⁱ, as printed to the fifths.

body L11-L19: «Burgess», «Whitney», «Varāha–Mihira», «Brahmagupta», «Āryabhaṭa», «Colebrooke» and «Colebrooke’s» are letter-spaced; «Sūrya–Siddhānta» (L11, L15), «9–12» and «Varāha–Mihira» have long dashes (5.2 to 5.5 pt), «243-44» a hyphen (2.2 pt). In the Sūrya-Siddhānta (III, 9-12) the equinox librates 27° each way, 600 times in a great age of 4 320 000 years: 600 · 108° : 4 320 000 = 54″ a year, as printed.
body L20-L21: the dashes after «b)» and «I.» measure 9.6 and 10.1 pt; the dash of «34–37» is joined to the 4 and is long (5.8 pt).

body L22-L26: «Ptolemaeus» and «Menelao» are letter-spaced; «9–10» and «12–13» have long dashes (5.3 and 5.5 pt). The year 845 of Nabonassar, the first of Trajan in Ptolemy's reckoning, began on 30 July 97 (Julian), so that 15 Mechir fell on 10 January 98 and 18 Mechir on 13 January: the nights of 15/16 and 18/19 Mechir are those of 10/11 and 13/14 January 98. The printed 9-10 and 12-13 February are the dates of 15 and 18 Mechir in the fixed Alexandrian calendar (1 Mechir = 26 January), not in the Egyptian calendar of the Almagest, by which Nallino dates the year 885 on p. 292 (20 July 137). The printed dates are kept.

notes_left L1-L4: the end of note 7 of p. 292. «Rudloff», «Hochheim», «al-Ǵaghmīnī» and «Chrysococcae» are letter-spaced; «al-Ǵaghmīnī» has a hyphen (2.9 pt). The dash before «De» measures 5.3 pt, with a speck after it. 68 lunar years of 354 1/3 days are 24 097 days, 65.97 solar years of 365 1/4 days: 66, as printed.

notes_left L5-L13: «Abū ’l–faẓl i ‘Allāmī» (L5, L10), «Ibn Yūnus», «Caussin», «Qāḍī-zādeh», «Naṣīr ad-dīn» and «Suter», divided between L12 and L13, are letter-spaced; «’l–faẓl» (L5, L10) and «al–A‘lam» have long dashes (4.4 pt each), «Āyīn-i-akbarī» and «ad-dīn» hyphens (3.0 and 3.5 pt); the dash before «Ibn» measures 7.7 pt. The full stop of «inc.» did not print; a gap of its width stands before «23». By the tabular calendar counted from 15 July 622, 1 Muḥarram 375 fell on 23 May 985, as printed (24 May from 16 July 622).

notes_left L14-L19: «Steinschneider» is letter-spaced; the full stop after «M» did not print, and a gap of its width stands before «Steinschneider». «t XX» is printed without a full stop. «soixante-dix» and «1887-88» have hyphens (3.4 and 2.2 pt).
notes_left L17-L19: Addenda, p. LXXVII («293, adn. 5»): for «pag. 97» read p. 25 of the Bullettino (97 of the separately published book).

notes_right L1-L9: «Sédillot» and «az-Zarqālī» (L3) are letter-spaced; «az-Zarqālī» (L3) has a hyphen (4.1 pt), «1845-50» one of 2.8 pt. The 6 of «(6)» prints broken, like U, and specks stand over the i of «trepidationis» (L8).

notes_right L10-L19: «Whitney», «Thibaut» and «Bhāskara» are letter-spaced; «244-49», «432-33», «indo-arischen», «Siddhānta-Śiromaṇi» and «Sūrya-Siddhānta» have hyphens (2.8, 3.2, 2.3, 2.8 and 3.0 pt), and the dash before «Bhāskara» measures 6.8 pt. The parenthesis opened before «Grundriss» (L13) is not closed in the print: its closing parenthesis did not print, and a gap of its width (3.4 pt) stands between «9» and the full stop (L14).
